annotation.title_clean: House Bill No. 455 (Enrolled): Autonomous Commercial Motor Vehicles
annotation.title_en: House Bill No. 455 (Enrolled): Autonomous Commercial Motor Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Louisiana Legislature (Representative Terry Landry et al.)
annotation.summary_en: Louisiana Act (HB 455, 2019) enacting R.S. 32:400.1–400.8 to govern autonomous commercial motor vehicles. It lets them operate without a driver present if registered, federally certified, able to reach a minimal risk condition and insured for $2 million. It also covers remote drivers and teleoperation, and preserves existing liability law.
key_provisions_or_claims: Autonomous commercial vehicles governed exclusively by this Part; Department of Transportation and Development is sole authority
Operation without a driver requires registration, FMVSS certification, minimal risk condition capability and $2M liability coverage
Operator must submit written certification statement to DOTD before driverless operation
Remote drivers are treated as vehicle operators, must hold proper licence, and teleoperated vehicles have similar criteria
Existing liability law is not preempted; Louisiana law resolves choice-of-law conflicts
